name: Hashima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hashima city emblem in light blue: a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Hashima, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 November 1964.

features.role: Hashima city emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
